```
['create a version object by parsing a PEP 440 compliant version string', 'test the Version class comparison operators for sorting and equality checks', 'build a script to extract epoch, release, pre-release, post, dev, and local version segments', 'review the Version class properties for major, minor, micro, is_prerelease, is_postrelease, is_devrelease', 'summarize how _cmpkey generates comparison keys for PEP 440 version ordering']

```
